The fonts link is permitted by S2.4 and the photo sourcing is declared in charter review item 11, so the defect is the notice's silence, not the requests.

verdict: CONFORMANT, no gate fails. First full S1-S10 walk of this surface. Every gate row passes: separate app (S1.2), token discipline with zero raw colour outside tokens.css (S2.2), the full regenerated contrast matrix clear on every ground the site reaches (S2.3), no-db with no DB client and no provisioned backend (S5.1, S5.4), no secret and no foreign write (S6.1 to S6.3), charter and repo routes reconciling both ways (S8.4a), the pinned checker held rather than copied (S8.5), zero prose em-dashes (S9.1). Two IMPORTANT findings, both on the privacy notice and both first proved on the deployed page: it describes a newsletter that does not exist, and it omits two Google transfers that happen before any click. The first is a spine defect this lane is barred from fixing and is raised to the Factory. Four raises to the Factory in total, including a verify.mjs pin eight commits behind the seed and a 1.8.25 S3.2 wording that, read literally, fails every site in the fleet the moment it enables a module.
